name: Auto Set Leave Approver
script:
# Auto set leave approver to bypass mandatory check
if not doc.leave_approver:
    # Set to Administrator as default fallback
    doc.leave_approver = "Administrator"

name: Enviro Auto User Creation
script:
if doc.custom_create_login_user and doc.company_email and not doc.user_id:
    
    # 1. Create the System User
    if not frappe.db.exists("User", doc.company_email):
        new_user = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "User",
            "email": doc.company_email,
            "first_name": doc.first_name,
            "last_name": doc.last_name,
            "send_welcome_email": 0,
            "new_password": doc.custom_initial_password 
        })
        
        # Bypass strict password requirements for initial setup
        new_user.flags.ignore_password_policy = True
        new_user.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        
        # 2. Map the Position Title (Job Role) to the User Role
        if doc.custom_position_title:
            job_role = doc.custom_position_title
            
            # If the Job Role doesn't exist in the System Roles list yet, create it
            if not frappe.db.exists("Role", job_role):
                new_role = frappe.new_doc("Role")
                new_role.role_name = job_role
                new_role.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            
            # Assign the linked role to the user
            new_user.append("roles", {"role": job_role})
            
        # Always assign the standard 'Employee' role as a baseline
        new_user.append("roles", {"role": "Employee"})
            
        # Save the user with their new roles
        new_user.save(ignore_permissions=True)
            
    # 3. Link the new User ID back to the Employee Profile
    frappe.db.set_value("Employee", doc.name, "user_id", doc.company_email)

name: Generate Driver Job Cards
script:
# Loop through the services quoted to the customer
for item in doc.items:
    
    # Grab the Job Card Type the salesperson selected (default to Standard if left blank)
    job_type = item.get("custom_job_card_type") or "Standard"
    
    # Fetch Site details if available
    site_details = {}
    if doc.get("custom_site"):
        site_details = frappe.db.get_value("Site", doc.custom_site, 
            ["site_email_address", "industry_type", "site_address", "site_contact_person", "site_contact_mobile"], as_dict=1) or {}

    # Find a valid Sales Person (Mandatory field on Job Card)
    sales_person = doc.get("sales_person")
    if not sales_person or not frappe.db.exists("Sales Person", sales_person):
        # Fallback 1: Try to find any Sales Person linked to the owner
        sales_person = frappe.db.get_value("Sales Person", {"employee": ["in", frappe.get_all("Employee", filters={"user_id": doc.owner}, pluck="name")]}, "name")
        
        # Fallback 2: Use "Sales Team" or the first available Sales Person
        if not sales_person:
            sales_person = frappe.db.get_value("Sales Person", {"name": "Sales Team"}, "name") or frappe.db.get_value("Sales Person", {}, "name")

    # Create the new driver task
    new_job = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Enviro Job Card",
        "job_card_type": job_type,
        "source_quotation": doc.name,
        "customer": doc.get("party_name") or doc.get("customer"),
        "site": doc.get("custom_site"),
        "status": "Open",
        "job_instructions": f"Task: {item.item_name}\nDescription: {item.description or ''}\nQty: {item.qty}",
        
        # New Mandatory Fields (Automated from Site/Quotation)
        "site_name": doc.get("custom_site") or "Enviro Site",
        "site_contact_email": site_details.get("site_email_address") or doc.get("custom_site_email") or "",
        "industry_type": site_details.get("industry_type") or "Foods",
        "sales_person": sales_person,
        
        # Secondary Logistics Data
        "site_address": site_details.get("site_address", ""),
        "site_contact_name": site_details.get("site_contact_person", ""),
        "site_contact_mob": site_details.get("site_contact_mobile", ""),
        "job_creation_date": frappe.utils.today()
    })
    
    new_job.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    
frappe.msgprint(f"Driver Job Cards successfully generated and sent to Dispatch.")

name: Enviro Weekly Timesheet - Auto Populate Days
script:
# Only populate if the table is empty
if doc.week_beginning and not doc.timesheet_table:
    
    for i in range(7):
        # 1. Add days safely using frappe.utils
        current_date_str = frappe.utils.add_days(doc.week_beginning, i)
        
        # 2. Convert the string to a date object just to extract the day name ("Monday", etc.)
        date_obj = frappe.utils.getdate(current_date_str)
        day_name = date_obj.strftime("%A")
        
        # 3. Append the row to the child table
        row = doc.append("timesheet_table", {})
        row.date = current_date_str
        row.day = day_name

name: Track Quotation Approvals
script:
# v10.3 - Fixed Operation validation by using empty string
def log_activity(sbj, d):
    # Log to Error Log for debugging
    frappe.log_error('Logging activity: ' + str(sbj), 'EHB Notification DEBUG')
    
    # Check for duplicate logs to avoid spam
    if not frappe.db.exists('Activity Log', {'subject': sbj, 'reference_name': d.name}):
        al = frappe.get_doc({
            'doctype': 'Activity Log',
            'subject': sbj,
            'reference_doctype': 'Quotation',
            'reference_name': d.name,
            'timeline_doctype': 'Quotation',
            'timeline_name': d.name,
            'status': 'Success'
            # 'operation': 'Workflow Approval'  <-- Removed to avoid validation error
        })
        al.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

# Client Approval
client_status = doc.get('custom_client_approval_status')
if client_status in ['Accepted', 'Approved', 'Yes']:
    log_activity('Quotation Accepted by Client', doc)

# Accounts Approval
accounts_status = doc.get('custom_accounts_approval_status')
if accounts_status in ['Approved', 'Accepted', 'Yes']:
    log_activity('Quotation Approved by Accounts', doc)

# Sales Approval
if doc.docstatus == 1:
    log_activity('Quotation Approved by Sales', doc)

name: Track Job Scheduling
script:
# v11.2 - Fixed notification trigger logic
def log_activity(sbj, d):
    # Check if we already logged this milestone to avoid duplicates
    if not frappe.db.exists('Activity Log', {'subject': sbj, 'reference_name': d.name}):
        al = frappe.get_doc({
            'doctype': 'Activity Log',
            'subject': sbj,
            'reference_doctype': 'Enviro Job',
            'reference_name': d.name,
            'timeline_doctype': 'Enviro Job',
            'timeline_name': d.name,
            'status': 'Success'
        })
        al.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

# Trigger for new jobs or status transitions
is_new = doc.get_db_value('name') is None
current_status = doc.status
old_status = doc.get_db_value('status')

if is_new or (current_status == 'Scheduled' and old_status != 'Scheduled'):
    log_activity('Job Scheduled: ' + str(doc.name), doc)
